verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs say the Cloud API lets you pick a different base image (such as the minimal GPU Base image) and add launch-time cloud-init instructions. Together these let a developer approximate a custom environment on ODC instances. However, there is no documented way to bring your own Docker image or save and upload a custom machine template, so the 'exact environment' part rests on choosing from Lambda's images plus scripting at boot. Missing for 10: running your own Docker/container image, uploading or saving custom machine images or templates, a listing of which base images are selectable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: the API allows you to use a different base image for your instance
Use if: You want a minimal working setup with a high degree of control over your Python environment.
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using cloud-init
